content: PagerDuty alert list shows Status (triggered/resolved/suppressed/suspended), Severity, Summary, Source, Class, Component, Group (PD-CEF fields), Created, Incident Title, Service/Integration. Alerts have only 2 states: triggered/resolved. Incidents filter by Open/Triggered/Acknowledged/Resolved/Any. Severity is per-alert (critical/warning/error) mapped to service impact.
